Notice Of Hearing On Petition
Off Calendar Aug-21-2026 Off Calendar
MINI MINUTES:

Appearance:
Joshua Jamil Teal in pro per plaintiff.

Hearing Held: No contest was received from Mr. Teal. The Court explained to Mr. Teal that the motion he filed was off calendar. The Court further explained that the Department posts its tentative ruling one day before the scheduled motion hearing and advised Mr. Teal that he should review the tentative ruling prior to appearing in Court. The Court explained that the motion was taken off calendar because the Court's Register of Actions does not reflect that the City had been served with the summons and petition or had otherwise appeared in this matter. Additionally, there was no proof of service on file demonstrating that the City had been properly notified of the hearing. Mr. Teal explained that service of the documents has not been successful and requests if this matter can be continued. The Court denied the request and advised Mr. Teal to seek legal advice for further guidance regarding the service requirements and appropriate next steps.The matter was discussed, and upon conclusion of the hearing, the Court adopted the tentative ruling.

PETITIONER JOSHUA TEAL's Hearing On Petition.

Off calendar without prejudice to being refiled. The court's register of actions does not show that the City has been served with a summons and the petition or otherwise appeared in this case nor is there any proof of service showing that the City was informed about this hearing.

Visiting Judge: Harold E. Kahn; Clerk: M. Macadangdang; Not Reported. (302/HEK)
